findings.finding: Same physical App registered through ancestor aliases could bypass reference/running guards keyed by lexical path.
findings.resolution: Before invoking Trash, aggregate all same canonical App targets and enforce all related running states and reference IDs. Also recognize host paths outside workbench as the logical App package.

findings.finding: Case-sensitive .app/layout detection could fall back to trashing only the signed Resources workbench subtree.
findings.resolution: Resolve native canonical root; identify .app extension without case sensitivity; allow only exact complete workbench layout within an App and refuse other App subtrees.

findings.finding: Expanded outer-App target needed lexical and parent-entry protection for data/home symlink entries which resolve outside the App.
findings.resolution: Guard target against lexical protected paths, native canonical paths, and canonical parent plus final entry before Trash.

findings.finding: Running E2E fixture used own process PID, which migrationPidAlive explicitly excludes.
findings.resolution: Use an actual owned live child and killOwnTree cleanup; no earlier direct execution or real Trash side effect occurred.

findings.finding: New Mac failure codes lacked localized messages and unsupported-platform text still claimed only Windows.
findings.resolution: Added three actionable failure messages in Chinese and English and generalized unsupported-platform text.

findings.finding: New permanent alias unit called nonexistent invalidateConfigCache and did not reach running-guard assertions.
findings.resolution: Use existing mutateConfig write chain; all four focused units pass including both reference and running cases.

findings.finding: MCP resources/read stripped POSIX leading slash from published config file URI.
findings.resolution: pathToFileURL/fileURLToPath encode/decode native absolute paths and Unicode/space/#/%, reject remote/nonfile/malformed/query/fragment requests, and samePathKey confines reads to masked configured config.

findings.finding: Native shell interruption markers alone could pass despite cleanupIncomplete=true.
findings.resolution: Mac MCP and native shell paths now require cleanupScope=owned-group-and-observed and cleanupIncomplete=false; actual first MCP PID/birth identity must disappear. Windows checks retained; no claim about arbitrary escaped descendants.

findings.finding: Mac launcher fixture created fallback node under parent HOME then launched with different child HOME.
findings.resolution: One launchHome environment is reused for both seeding .local/bin/node and spawning the real launcher.

findings.finding: Mac guides cited trial-manifest.json as source of DMG checksum.
findings.resolution: Application/packager commits reference trial-manifest, image checksum references distribution.json/.dmg.sha256.

finalTestDeltaReview.serialInterrupt: Default first file_write is an actual serial barrier and verifies its filesystem change; next two reads are honestly refused. Original contiguous pairing, steer injection and completion assertions retained.
finalTestDeltaReview.readIslandInterrupt: Explicit RUYI_STEER_READ_ISLAND=1 keeps three actual preexecuted read results and zero false not-executed refusals, with same pairing/steer completion checks.
finalTestDeltaReview.cancelTransport: Remote consumption is INFO on Mac because notifications are fire-and-forget; deterministic production-class unit verifies matching requestId/reason packet before immediate kill. No cleanup delay introduced.
finalTestDeltaReview.cleanup: MCP PID/birth observed disappearance plus own-group/observed complete cleanup metadata required; native bash mirrors Windows PowerShell behavior on Mac.
finalTestDeltaReview.packagedTrash: New candidates declare nativeTrash=true and execute installed backend via RUYI_TEST_SERVER_JS plus bundled helper via RUYI_TRASH_HELPER. Native negative guard permits only exact disposable App in final positive control; helper SHA bound, full App restored and report uses wx. Installed App signature/inventory reverified after the nested journey. Old P6-02 manifests retain prior branch and do not falsely acquire new coverage.
finalTestDeltaReview.guiIsolation: 16 existing AppKit/screen/focus/input cases added to existing exclusive set; no previously exclusive files removed and no per-case assertion/timeout altered.
finalTestDeltaReview.legacyContracts: 121 inventory retains facts.json equality and other sweeps; subagent wrapper remains required to delegate through desktop context to same body; pairing message honestly states1 missing saved result with execution/impact unconfirmed and no replay.
